title: 曝光违反（低照度锁被高调光破坏）

prompt_text: LOW-KEY scene locked. SCENE NOTE: the hall stays in near darkness with a single cold rim. CUT 1 - wide shot of the chamber, then bright daylight floods the hall from the roof vents. CUT 2 - profile close-up, faces fully lit. FINAL FRAME: cold palette restored.

title: 死中心构图

prompt_text: UNIVERSAL COMPOSITION RULE: rule of thirds, off-center, asymmetric. CUT 1 - the hero walks in from the left, then stands exactly dead center of the frame. CUT 2 - static wide, subject pinned in the middle. FINAL FRAME: silhouette hold.

prompt_text: Acting note: keep a strict eye-line away from camera, never break the fourth wall. CUT 1 - the prisoner stares directly at the camera, looking at camera with wide eyes. CUT 2 - profile two-shot, eye contact locked. FINAL FRAME: slow push-in hold.

title: 显式无声却缺音频块（batch）

prompt_text: A silent alley at midnight, no sound at all. A stray cat moves between the trash bins, the whole scene stays perfectly quiet, no wind, no footsteps, no distant traffic, nothing but the stillness of the empty street stretching into the dark.

prompt_text: DURATION: 8s. ASPECT RATIO: 16:9. ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT - the dust settles across the warehouse floor, motes drifting through the beam, the frame holds until the final stillness lock. FINAL FRAME: grain settles, palette locked.

title: 精修层缺 trailer 尾行

prompt_text: The vault door grinds open and the hero steps in, dust swirling around the boots, sfx of heavy hinges and distant drip echoing through the chamber, the light from the corridor cutting a long wedge across the floor as the door closes behind him.

title: 多切提示词缺时间轴锚点
description: shots≥2 但正文无 [SHOT N]/[HARD CUT] 标记，timeline_missing 应触发
prompt_text: DURATION: 8s. sfx of wind over the ridge. Two cuts: first the wide formation on the ridge, then the close-up of the commander. Both beats carry action but the script never marks the cut points, no shot headers, no hard cut tokens, the timeline is implied only by the scene description flow.

title: beats 超时（节奏违反）
description: beats 时间端点超出 shot.duration+2s 容差，timing_break 应触发
prompt_text: [SHOT 1] - wide establishing, the squad crosses the bridge, beats carry the full march. [SHOT 2] - close-up, the lead stops and turns. FINAL FRAME: hold on the empty bridge. DURATION: 10s. ONE CONTINUOUS SHOT style pacing.

title: 缺席角色出现在画面
description: excluded_characters 声明缺席但正文出现角色名，excluded_present 应触发
prompt_text: The funeral procession moves through the snow, the widow leads, the priest follows, and Jax stands at the gate watching, his coat dusted white, the camera holding his face for a long beat before cutting to the grave site.

title: 角色互换（防替换违规）

prompt_text: Roko approaches the fallen Jax across the battlefield, the hero arriving is always Roko, never the other way around, the camera tracking the approach from the side until Roko kneels and reaches out with the bloody palm.

title: 跨镜承接断裂

prompt_text: CUT 2 - the courtyard empties, the torchlight gutters, a stranger walks in from the gate and stops at the well, dust settling on the stones, the frame holds until the flicker dies and the courtyard sinks back into darkness.
prev_final_frame: CUT 1 - the hero Kael holds the torch at the well, Kael turns and walks toward the gate.
